name: Death From Below
summary: Aboard Shakes O'Breen's ship in the Arathi Highlands, the Daggerspine naga gather to strike. You stand with O'Breen, man the cannon, and help the crew sail back to Booty Bay.

sections.title: Holding the Deck
sections.body: After the Sunken Treasure, Shakes O'Breen sees the Daggerspine naga gathering to attack. They are ruthless and will keep coming until O'Breen is dead. O'Breen puts the crew's safety ahead of their own and asks you to defend them. Without O'Breen's knowledge of the seas, the crew cannot reach Booty Bay. So you wait aboard with O'Breen for the naga to rise from the water.

sections.title: Afterward
sections.body: When the attack ends, O'Breen says the ship will leave as soon as the tide rises. O'Breen would have offered you a place on the crew, but sees that you have bigger fish to fry.

faq.answer: The Daggerspine naga gather to attack Shakes O'Breen. They come from the sea and will keep coming until O'Breen is dead.

faq.q: Why is protecting Shakes O'Breen so vital to the crew?
faq.answer: Shakes O'Breen puts the crew's safety ahead of their own. Without O'Breen's knowledge of the seas, the crew cannot sail back to Booty Bay.

faq.q: How do you repel the naga assault?
aliases: how to beat death from below
faq.answer: You stay aboard Shakes O'Breen's ship and man the cannon. You drive back the naga as they come from the sea.

faq.q: Where does this defense take place?
faq.answer: You defend Shakes O'Breen's ship in the Arathi Highlands as the naga come from the sea.
